gloss: a wasted trip; going somewhere in vain

definitions.gloss: a wasted trip; a futile errand; going somewhere in vain
definitions.explanation: The act of going somewhere only to find that the trip was pointless — the person was out, the shop was closed, the item was sold out, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{無駄足|むだあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}んだ→踏む：01197_fumu⟧。
examples.english: The shop was closed and I made the trip for nothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧おけば、{無駄足|むだあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}ま→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: If I had called ahead to check, I could have avoided the wasted trip.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧ (waste) and ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot/trip). The set phrase {無駄足|むだあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ means 'to make a wasted trip.' Often used when expressing frustration after going somewhere only to find it was pointless.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無駄足|むだあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ (to make a wasted trip)
- {無駄足|むだあし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to turn out to be a wasted trip)
- {無駄足|むだあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}ませる→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ (to send someone on a wild goose chase)
